lines: I want to keep believing forever.
I want to keep feeling this way until the end.
I should have a reason to live.
They smile at me with cold eyes.
A person whose soul has been soaked.
Do you even feel the pain of shedding tears?
In a world where you can’t even say what you want, it’s poison.
I’ll live without deceiving myself, oh, oh.
Facing reality straight on.
To have pride.
Fighting is sometimes necessary.
Sitting on the stairs.
Talking about an endless dream.
We kept talking until daybreak.
The season changes subtly.
Unconsciously I lower my gaze.
Do we get used to being swept away?
In a world where even small dreams can’t be seen, it’s poison.
I want to always love being myself, oh, oh.
The days I live freely.
Because I want to cherish them.
I’ll start walking the road I want now.
I don’t want to be manipulated by dirty lies and words, poison.
I won’t turn away from honest feelings.
In a world where you can’t even say what you want, it’s poison.
I’ll live without deceiving myself, oh, oh.
Facing reality straight on.
To have pride.
Fighting is sometimes necessary.
